assumptions: Express does not expose an AbortSignal on IncomingMessage; the handbook's 'Variations' section explicitly documents this and prescribes creating one AbortController per request and aborting it from res.on('close', ...). The Option returned by Cause.findErrorOption uses ._tag / Option.isSome pattern consistent with Effect 4. Layer.provide(serviceLayer, depLayer) correctly wires dependencies; pipe style (serviceLayer.pipe(Layer.provide(depLayer))) is used as shown in the handbook. process.exit(0) is called after dispose() so Node does not linger.
